versions.changelog:
claude-code-openclaw-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release integrating Claude Code CLI with OpenClaw.
- Enables AI-assisted codebase reading, file editing, code review, debugging, and automation from OpenClaw.
- Supports session management, custom models, structured JSON output, and advanced batch/sub-agent workflows.
- Provides clear usage examples, troubleshooting guidance, and links to official documentation.
